# Tables for: How the four models differ on a pulse

Statistic: the paired **mean** response per Gt of the pulsed gas, 2030 pulse, the 6-marker van Vuuren analysis set, the same for every model (vvLN is excluded: by 2300 its baseline is near or below pre-industrial in both climate models). `[SAME-STATISTIC]` verified: the cross-model and duration tables are the same numbers, bit for bit. FACTS is run at ANNUAL output (pyear_step 1) and enters only where it is climate-driven (Marcus's 09-12c rule): its totals to 2100, thermal expansion and glaciers to 2300. `n/a (09-12c)` marks a FACTS cell outside that rule, which is every T3 cell and every T4 share, both of which need the 2030-2300 total.
